claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal between the USA and the Dominican Republic takes place on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The venue is LoanDepot Park, Miami.
FOX Deportes will provide Spanish-language coverage.
The TV channels are FS1 and Fox Deportes.
The live streams are Fubo, FOX One, FOX Sports App, and DirecTV.
